context:
Goal: an answer you save on the waiting page reaches its session at once, and is never lost or stale.
Problem (goal): today two stores hold your answers, the page's database and a git copy made at each wake, and they lag or disagree; measured 12:40 CST, the git copy held 519 items against the page's 577.
Based on (ruling): R28, your Nov 11 11:50 CST words: "the actual page gets its database disabled if that's possible ... I just care about the outcomes not the plumbing".
Based on (read): measured 12:35 CST: a claude.ai page cannot call any outside site, so a git route needs the page moved to your own site.
Departs from: main, the page database plus a git copy at each wake — a makes the database the one store and git a backup only; b moves the page and its answers to git on your own site.

lastAnswer.note: In chat 12:40 CST: "the artifact is never operated upon by two accounts at the same time ... so as long as the artifact/data gets exported in a timely enough matter (not real time) it's morerso okay ... if ... the setup with all the lanes + triage is causing some sorta internal lag, then we should still be open to the switchr otue"

options.gain: No lag and one store, with little to build.
options.how: Sessions read your answers live from the page's database; the copy at each wake is dropped; a backup export to git is read only to recover a lost page.
options.label: The page's database is the one store (Recommended)
options.lose: History and safety across an account move rest on the backup; it keeps the database, against R28's wording but not its outcome.

options.gain: Full history in git, and it survives an account move.
options.how: Move the page to a small site on your Cloudflare account that writes each answer to git.
options.label: Git on your own site
options.lose: A new site, a GitHub token, a deploy and a login gate: several lanes, and you run setup commands on your computer.

ref: coordinator 12:48 CST Nov 12 (its clock), from your 12:38 CST ask to explain the need by outcome
reply: Filed: the page's database is the one store, with a timely export to git as backup. Lane page-data-one-store rewrites decision waiting-page-one-store on PR #2829. Route B is parked as the fallback if same-account lag is measured.
short: Answers: page database or git site
title: Where your page answers live: the page's own database, or git on your own site
why: You asked why workers, git and Cloudflare are needed; this is the route choice that decides it.
